canonical_executed_expression:
(lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let ((v v))
                      (if (zero? v)
                          0
                          (let* ((on-border (or
                                              (or (zero? r) (!= (at g (- r 1) c) v))
                                              (or (= r (- h 1)) (!= (at g (+ r 1) c) v))
                                              (or (zero? c) (!= (at g r (- c 1)) v))
                                              (or (= c (- w 1)) (!= (at g r (+ c 1)) v)))))
                            (if on-border
                                v
                                (let* ((dr (let loop
                                                ((d 1))
                                                (if (and
                                                      (>= (- r d) 0)
                                                      (= (at g (- r d) c) v))
                                                    (loop (+ d 1))
                                                    d)))
                                       (dc (let loop
                                                ((d 1))
                                                (if (and
                                                      (>= (- c d) 0)
                                                      (= (at g r (- c d)) v))
                                                    (loop (+ d 1))
                                                    d)))
                                       (ir (- dr 1))
                                       (ic (- dc 1)))
                                  (if (zero? (remainder (+ ir ic) 2)) 0 v)))))))))
